content: Ulenganesu wa kutoghulana
Bhalongu bhangu, bho, ngachemmanyi ndandi nongela na bhala bhabhajimanyi shelia kubha shelia juntawala mundu chikahi paakubha mwome?
Kwa ndandi mbomba joabhi na ndomi akongakiki na shelia kwaka ndomi waki chikahi paakubha mwome, nambu ndomi anaapotili, abhopuliwi na shelia jaka ndomi jela.

Bhela chikahi ndomi paakubha mwome, ngati anaabhi na mwanalomi jongi alowakeka mgone. Nambu ndomi anapotile, mbomba akubha alijeka, ngacheakongakeka kabhete na shelia heji, na hata ngati anaatoghuliki na mwanalomi jongi, akubha nga mgone.

Bhelabhela bhalongu bhango, mwenga nanamu mpotili kubhokana na Shelia, kwa indela ja hyegha jaka Yesu Kristo, mpata kubha mali ghaka mundu jongi, jola joakahyokike kuhuma kwa bhabhawile, nahuli tubhaleta bhandu kwaka Chapanga.
Kwa ndandi patukabhi tutama kwa kulonguheka na hyegha, utokulelu kwa mahoku, ghoukabhi kwa ndandi ja Shelia, ukahengiki lihengu mu hyegha hitu na ghokapi ghatukahengiki ghakatupeliki mu kupotela.

Nambu sajenu tubhopuliki kuhuma mu Shelia, maghambu tupotili kubhokana na lijambu lela lelikatubhekiki tepani bhatumwa. Henu tutumakila kujengalanela na matamu ghahenu gha Roho, na nga kujengalanela na hali jela ja Shelia jejalembakike.
Shelia na Mahoku

Bho, henu tupwaga bhole? Bho, Shelia nde mahoku? Ngabhela hata pachokope! Kwa ndandi nganakalimanyi lihoku nambu kwa Shelia, maghambu nganakamanyi kutokulela nde kike, ngati Shelia ngajakapwaghike, “Ngawitokulela.”
Nambu lihoku lakapatiki mbekenyu kwa amuli jela, jakahengiki mkati jangu kila ntundu wa utokulelu. Kwa ndandi lihoku panga na shelia lipotile.
Nanatu nakabhi mwomi pamwandi hapa panga shelia, nambu pajahikiki amuli jela, lihoku lakahyokiki, na nakapotile.
Nakaweni kubha amuli jejapalakiki kuleta womi jela, kwangu nepani jakaletiki kupotela.
Maghambu lihoku kwa kupata mbekenyu kwa amuli jela, jakatehi kungolowa, na bhela jakangomike kupetela amuli heji.
Bhela Shelia nde jihuhu, na amuli jela nde jihuhu, na ja chakaka, na kabhete nde jambone.

Henu, bho, jela jejibhi jambone jakabhi nyiwa kwangu nepani? Ngabhela hata pachokope! Nambu lihoku, nahuli libhonikana kubha nde lihoku chakaka, likahengiki nyiwa mkati jangu kwa indela ja chinyahi chela, nahuli kwa amuli jela lihoku lijonjukikaje kubha lihakau nakanopi.
Ngondo mkati jaka mundu
Kwa ndandi tumanyi kubha Shelia nde ja kiroho, nambu nepani nde mundu wa kihyegha, nombasiki kubha mtumwa wa mahoku.
Ngachemanyi chenikihenga, maghambu lela lembalika kulihenga, ngachenilihenga, nambu lela lenilihakalila leniheli nde lenilihenga.
Nambu anangati nhenga lela langakulipala kuhenga, nde kubha nyetakela kubha Shelia nde jambone.
Bhela nga nepani kabhete nenhenga lela langakulipala kuhenga, nambu lihoku lela lelitama mkati jangu.
Kwa ndandi manyi kubha mkati jangu, yani, mkati ja hyegha jangu, ngachelitama lilobhi lambone, ndandi kupala mbala, nambu kuhenga lijambu lelibhi lambone ngachenhweza.
Maghambu lijambu lambone lenilipala lela, ngachenilihenga, nambu lijambu lihakau langakulipala lela nde lenilihenga.
Bhela anangati lela langakulipala nde lenilihenga, nga nepani nenilihenga, nambu lihoku lela lelitama mkati jangu.
Bhela nijiweni shelia ajeji, kubha kwangu nepani pambala kuhenga lelibhi lambone, lela lelibhi lihakau nde lenilihaghula.
Kwa ndandi nijihekalela Shelia jaka Chapanga kwa mtima wa mkati.

Nambu mona kubhi na shelia jengi jejihenga lihengu mu hyegha jangu, shelia jejipengana na jela jejijetakalewa na malangu ghangu. Na bhela jimeka mya mkongeka wa shelia ja mahoku jejihenga lihengu mu hyegha jangu.
Kahochu nenga! Bho, nde nane joanangengalyaje kuhuma mu hyegha jenjenu jejimbeleka mu kupotela?

Nunchengu Chapanga, kwa indela jaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo! Bhela, aje nde hali jangu, nepani kwa malangu ghangu, nijitumakila Shelia jaka Chapanga, nambu kwa hyegha jangu nijitumakila shelia ja mahoku.
